Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (login ok/401/422, case-insensitive email, /me 200/401, 5-fail lockout -> 429 on 6th even with correct pw, change-password 400/422/401/success + old token invalidated via pw_version + new pw login, technician create w/ password, tech 403 on admin routes, admin reset tech pw invalidates old token, deactivated tech -> 403 on login and /me, WS /api/ws accepts JWT). minor.issue: Lockout keyed only by email (in-memory _fails): any anonymous user can lock the single admin out for 15 min with 5 wrong attempts (DoS). Consider keying by email+IP or adding a progressive delay instead of hard lock for the owner account.
_fails dict grows unbounded with unknown emails; unknown-email path skips bcrypt (timing-based user enumeration). Low priority.
Does not reject new_password == current_password. Low priority.
Already-open WS connections are not closed when pw_version changes / tech is deactivated (token only validated at connect). Low priority.

ui_bugs.issue: Key button on admin's own row resets own password via /technicians/{id}/password, which invalidates the admin's current token -> 401 interceptor logs out without warning. Consider hiding it for self or redirecting to /crm/conta.

issues: Helper text 'Guarde-a antes de criar a conta' is leftover Clerk sign-up wording; reword for password change context
